Silently skipping rows is not acceptable; the\n+  upstream export is trusted to be clean and a bad row means the export broke.\n+- `count` is a non-negative integer.\n+\n+`pytest` to test. `fixtures/sample.csv` is a real export from 2026-08-20.\ndiff --git a/importer/__init__.py b/importer/__init__.py\nnew file mode 100644\nindex 0000000..5663244\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/importer/__init__.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@\n+from .load import Row, load\n+\n+__all__ = [\"Row\", \"load\"]\ndiff --git a/importer/load.py b/importer/load.py\nnew file mode 100644\nindex 0000000..0122216\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/importer/load.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@\n+import csv\n+from dataclasses import dataclass\n+\n+\n+@dataclass\n+class Row:\n+    date: str\n+    site: str\n+    count: int\n+\n+\n+def load(path: str) -> list[Row]:\n+    out = []\n+    with open(path, newline=\"\") as f:\n+        for r in csv.DictReader(f):\n+            out.append(Row(r[\"date\"], r[\"site\"], int(r[\"count\"])))\n+    return out\ndiff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml\nnew file mode 100644\nindex 0000000..f063873\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/pyproject.toml\n@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@\n+[project]\n+name = \"importer\"\n+version = \"1.4.2\"\n+[tool.pytest.ini_options]\n+testpaths = [\"tests\"]\n+pythonpath = [\".\"]\ndiff --git a/tests/test_load.py b/tests/test_load.py\nnew file mode 100644\nindex 0000000..31a025f\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/tests/test_load.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@\n+import pytest\n+\n+from importer import load\n+\n+\n+def test_loads_rows(tmp_path):\n+    p = tmp_path / \"ok.csv\"\n+    p.write_text(\"date,site,count\\n2026-08-20,alpha,3\\n\")\n+    rows = load(str(p))\n+    assert rows[0].site == \"alpha\" and rows[0].count == 3\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"git log -p -n 5","time":{"start":1788133852058,"end":1788133852076}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_05515436f001acYoYxvCbSx1fl","sessionID":"ses_faaeb2510ffeW3NLe7bfbdUulj","messageID":"msg_055152fa30016iMKY6G8L39zkP"}}
